C1100.title: Ministry of Public Security Reports Cracking 79 Cases Involving AI Face-Swapping
C1100.summary: On August 10, 2023, the Ministry of Public Security held a press conference announcing that, in response to fraud targeting the public through AI face-swapping, public security authorities launched a special operation, solved 79 related cases, and arrested 515 suspects. Criminals mainly used photos as source material for AI face-swapping, impersonated others during video calls, and defrauded victims of money.
